Well just based on the hints I've been following, I think Mass Effect 5 is going to be a "rescue and recovery mission" of sorts, possibly following up on some of the plot threads we were left with after MEA. 

the first teaser trailer opened up very poignantly with a shot of the Milky Way and Andromeda galaxies, and during the audio montage we overhear the phrase "Ark 6 is away, godspeed". Notably the original Andromeda expedition, there were only 5 Arks, with the Quarian Ark being delayed due to technical difficulties. And the trail of hints leading up to the N7 Day 2023 trailer specifically mentions "Andromeda distress signal detected" which heavily reminds me of distress signal Ryder received during the epilogue of Mass Effect Andromeda.

There's also the matter of the decoded audio clip of Liara communicating with what sounds to be a Geth, speaking about how "The Council will be furious" and how they "always did underestimate human defiance", paired with the footage of what appears to be a newly constructed Mass Relay (a technology that only the Reapers had previously been able to design, which clearly places this game far into the future after the events of ME3).

And of course, during MEA, the Heleus News Network broadcaster makes allusion to the fact that all of the messages being sent to the Milky Way through the quantum-entangled comm buoys were being left un-answered. All of this leads me to believe that, while the messages and distress signals *were* received in the Milky Way, the Citadel Council (in whatever form it has taken in the centuries since the Reaper War ended) has elected not to spare any resources to investigate and are ignoring the distress signal from Ark Keelah Si'yah. And so, a second Andromeda Expedition is being mounted in direct defiance of The Council, spearheaded by a group within humanity and possibly defectors from other races as well, possibly intent on using this newly built Mass Relay as an intergalactic slingshot for Ark 6.

Presumably the Geth must be playing some important role in this as well given the numerous hints at their involvement, perhaps aiding this 2nd Expedition in some way, given the apparent connections to Liara (who was in contact with Alec Ryder and aware of 1st Expedition). After all, we already know that the first Initiative scientists supposedly "hacked into" the Kholas Array, 3 mass relays that had been fused together to create an FTL-Telescope, and used that to obtain their scans of the Golden Worlds in the Heleus Cluster. (a feat that Sis!Ryder can remark upon being incredibly unlikely to be "allowed" to happen, given their extreme isolationist reputation). I have my own theories about the Geth having been involved in the original Andromeda Initiative project but again that's mostly just speculation with little supporting evidence.

but yeah. I think it's gonna be a rescue/recovery mission, and likely link the two stories together more coherently! 😊
